verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own documented recurring automation is narrow: it can ask the team a question on a recurring schedule (e.g., every Monday at 9am) and collect the answers. That is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but it covers only one fixed workflow type. Templates are reusable setups rather than scheduled runs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, recurring task or automation triggers, agent- or API-driven schedule configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Basecamp asks your team questions on a schedule, like “What are you working on this week?” every Monday at 9am, and saves everyone’s answers in one place.
